title: Codex Security
summary: Codex Security is an open-source security scanning tool developed by OpenAI that detects potential vulnerabilities in code generated by AI coding assistants, helping developers identify and fix security issues before deployment.
problem_solved: Addresses the security risks of deploying AI-generated code without proper security review by providing automated vulnerability detection.
why_valuable: It bridges the critical security gap in AI-assisted development workflows, ensuring that code generated by AI tools meets security standards before production use.
